retention_justification: Official Q1 staging reservations change the general execution formula. These five retained plans all reserve Q=1024 at N=65664, where the generic indexer bound already exceeds the Q1 indexer and attention bounds. Every mapping, list, scalar, selected ledger, useful-P ledger and next-infeasible ledger in each complete recomputed plan equals its original. Source equality is not claimed; current and original source hashes are recorded separately.
boundary: CPU-only source/input and arithmetic audit of ECHO/serial_sparse history-only sessions with GPU-transient candidates. Original capacity results, supplied total/model-memory inputs, extra-headroom assumptions and the earlier DMA provenance remain unchanged. No model loading, GPU execution, new request-memory measurement, graph-pool validation, capacity-fill trajectory or physical-peak claim.
